integrity: Six science/status documents and a standalone exact-integer checker are included; the exhaustive affine-orbit certificate was recomputed before packaging.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only whether the minimal zero-sum length is at most four for multiplicative order eleven modulo primes; higher minima, higher prime powers, and other orders are not determined. Completeness of prior publication coverage is not independently established.
title: The complete three- and four-term zero-sum spectrum for cyclic subgroups of order eleven
